column1: # Freenove FNK0104S 4.0" ESP32-S3 (16 MB flash). Two OTA app slots for the /update page
# and a small SPIFFS (splash image + favicon) so the installer's merged image stays small
# (about 6 MB instead of the 13 MB the stock 16 MB table would need). The rest of the flash is unused.
# (The coredump partition sits after the end of the installer's merged image
column2: so it adds nothing to its size.)
